paragraphs.text: Vorosh (VOHR-ahsh) ), the Hunter , is a male primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.

Vorosh is a male primeval dragon from Dominaria that was seen during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria . He is a large ashen-scaled dragon, with greenish flecks and yellow ridge spikes. He wears elaborate golden jewelry around his neck, horns, wings, legs, and chest.
The four other alternate timeline primeval dragons are Intet , Numot , Oros , and Teneb .
